note: The act types that name an act only with their number and date: «legge» alone, «d.m.» alone, «decreto legislativo» alone name no act, and nothing can be opened from them. An act identifies itself when its type needs no number (a code, the Costituzione, a Treaty, an act the tables name) or when it has its number and its date. One list for every suite: before it the web (ACT_TYPES_REQUIRING_DETAILS) and the citation linker (_NUMBERED_ACT_TYPES) each kept their own: they disagreed on the decreto ministeriale (the linker had it, the web not), both lacked the DPCM, and the search's parser kept none (design docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-29-document-analysis-design.md §4.4). Types are written as the parser emits them and compared with their case folded («regolamento UE» from the presets is «regolamento ue»). Each suite keeps a copy (the Python image does not carry conventions/) and a test that compares it with this file.
types: decreto del presidente del consiglio dei ministri
